scenes.title: Cereal saved Airbnb
scenes.say: In two thousand eight, Airbnb was broke. Cereal saved it.

scenes.label: per box of 'Obama O's' and 'Cap'n McCain's'
scenes.say: The founders made election themed cereal boxes and sold them for forty dollars each.

scenes.label: raised to keep the company alive
scenes.say: They raised about thirty thousand dollars. Then Y Combinator invested, impressed by the hustle.

scenes.title: Resourcefulness beats resources.
scenes.say: Get creative. Follow for more founder stories.
